source_post.claim: Free Apache 2.0 ungated full duplex voice model, hears sarcasm; parity with GPT-4o-mini-audio claimed.

family.language: English, Chinese; multilingual comprehension claims not independent
family.base_model_claim: DuplexJev-32B-Para v1.5 derived from Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and Qwen3-ASR audio encoder; verify full tensor census
family.shared_brain_finetune: 32B common FP8 thinker in Tag and Flash is byte-identical for 19 large LFS components
family.license_claim: Apache-2.0 model cards and code NOTICE; third-party rights and older DuplexJev CC-BY-NC metadata require counsel review
family.usage_backend: Linux Python3.12 vLLM 0.30 vLLM-Omni 0.30 CUDA (Tag/Flash); E2E Linux NVIDIA driver >=580 CUDA13 code runtime

tag/NOTICE.summary:
Copyright 2026 Adventists.ai.

Sophon-Realtime-32B-Tag bundles model weights derived from the following works, each licensed under the Apache License 2.0:
- thinker/: derived from Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct by the Qwen team, Alibaba (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct),
  via DuplexJev-32B-Para (Adventists.ai) with a merged tag-writing adapter; quantized to FP8. Its audio encoder is derived from
  Qwen3-ASR (Qwen team, Alibaba, Apache License 2.0).
- talker/: tag-tts (Adventists.ai), derived from Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B by the FunAudioLLM team, Alibaba
  (https://github.com/FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice); the language model was fine-tuned to perform sound tags, the flow model was
  distilled to 4 steps, and the HiFT vocoder is redistributed unchanged.

flash/NOTICE.summary:
Copyright 2026 Adventists.ai.

Sophon-Realtime-32B-Flash bundles model weights derived from the following works, each licensed under the Apache License 2.0:
- thinker/: derived from Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct by the Qwen team, Alibaba (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct),
  via DuplexJev-32B-Para (Adventists.ai) with a merged tag-writing adapter; quantized to FP8. Its audio encoder is derived from

- talker/: derived from Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base by the Qwen team, Alibaba (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base);
  the language model was fine-tuned to perform sound tags. talker/speech_tokenizer/ is redistributed unchanged.

source_capacity.dedup_caveat: Counts dedup of source LFS payload SHA256 only. Non-LFS git blob duplicates and existing v27 shared payloads not deducted. Git blob SHA1 MUST NOT be treated as payload SHA256.

third_party_relicensing_flag.note: Both current author and intermediate repo have same publisher. Legitimate relicensing is possible; confirm provenance and commercial/redistribution authority, do not assert infringement.

unverified_benchmarks.gpu_used: one H100 80 GB, CUDA and vLLM Omni 0.30; independent runtime not tested

recommendation.tag: P0 research for conditional addition to future v28/v29 only after parameter/license/ABI gate
recommendation.flash: P1 paired differential weight component when byte overlap/rights checked
recommendation.e2e: P1 mechanism-preservation candidate; preview/2 GPUs, HOLD runtime

variants.reason_for_keeping_candidate: Voice-aware full duplex, barge-in, hesitation/emotion, independently trained expressive speech (CosyVoice-derived Tag TTS) and audited transcript; unlike simple standalone TTS.
Shares same brain as Tag but separate Qwen3-TTS-derived streaming speech model offers latency and concurrency tradeoff, not just quantization.

published_runtime_requirements.requirements: Linux NVIDIA driver>=580; two envs, no runtime test

variants.reason_for_keeping_candidate: Uses shared continuous speech representation and learned talker/decoder without separate TTS, a mechanism-specific experimental weight set; expensive and preview.
